Albinauric Shield.location: Drops from Albinaurics wielding it, found atop the church northwest of the Academy Gate Town Site of Grace.

Ant's Skull Plate.location: In a chest in Nokstella, Eternal City; head west from the Eternal City grace, up the stairs, into the room with a Nox Swordstress.

Banished Knight's Shield.location: Drops from Banished Knights; can be farmed from one near the Cathedral of Dragon Communion Site of Grace.

Beast Crest Heater Shield.location: Inside a chest at a camp along the road west of the Saintsbridge Site of Grace in east Stormhill.

Beastman's Jar-Shield.location: Drops from an Azula Beastman in the room near the Crumbling Beast Grave Depths Site of Grace.

Black Leather Shield.location: Sold by Pidia, Carian Servant at Caria Manor for 2,500 Runes.

Black Steel Greatshield.location: Dropped by Black Knight Garrew at Fog Rift Fort (near Castle Ensis).

Blue Crest Heater Shield.location: Sold by the Nomadic Merchant near Bellum Church in northwest Liurnia for 1,500 Runes; Confessor starting gear.

Blue-White Wooden Shield.location: On the outskirts of a building heading south from the South Raya Lucaria Gate Site of Grace.

Briar Greatshield.location: Dropped by Elemer of the Briar (Bell Bearing Hunter) at The Shaded Castle.

Buckler.location: Bandit class starting equipment; also sold by Gatekeeper Gostoc at Stormveil and Twin Maiden Husks at Roundtable Hold.

Candletree Wooden Shield.location: In a chest behind an illusory wall inside Sage's Cave.

Crucible Hornshield.location: Guaranteed drop from the Crucible Knight patrolling the bridges in the Siofra Aqueduct.

Cuckoo Greatshield.location: Drops from Cuckoo Knights of Raya Lucaria; farmable around Bellum Church / East Raya Lucaria Gate.

Distinguished Greatshield.location: Purchased from the Hermit Merchant at Hermit Merchant's Shack for 5,500 Runes.

Dragon Towershield.location: In a chest guarded by a Banished Knight, reached by dropping down from the Dragon Temple Rooftop Site of Grace.

Dragonclaw Shield.location: Dropped by the Draconic Tree Sentinel fought at Capital Outskirts.

Dueling Shield.location: In Shadow Keep; from the Storehouse First Floor grace, go north around the specimen pillar to the stairs.

Eclipse Crest Heater Shield.location: On a stone platform on the cliffside southwest of Tombsward Catacombs, northwest of the minor Erdtree.

Erdtree Greatshield.location: Dropped by the Tree Sentinel Duo guarding the gate at the Outer Wall Phantom Tree Site of Grace.

Fingerprint Stone Shield.location: In the Subterranean Shunning-Grounds; behind the chest after Mohg the Omen in the Cathedral of the Forsaken, move the altar to reveal the path.

Flame Crest Wooden Shield.location: On a corpse inside a small shack on the north side of Ailing Village.

Gilded Greatshield.location: Drops from Godrick Knights; one is found at Gatefront Ruins.

Gilded Iron Shield.location: On a corpse on a grave west of the Church of Pilgrimage.

Golden Beast Crest Shield.location: Dropped by the Grafted Scion in the Chapel of Anticipation (can be revisited later).

Golden Lion Shield.location: Given by Redmane Freyja after handing over the Letter for Freyja received from Sir Ansbach.

Hawk Crest Wooden Shield.location: Looted off a corpse in the large armory room next to the room with the Grafted Scion.

Heater Shield.location: Vagabond class starting equipment; purchased from the Twin Maiden Husks at Roundtable Hold for 1,500 Runes.

Horse Crest Wooden Shield.location: Purchased from Patches at Murkwater Cave for 1,000 Runes.

Ice Crest Shield.location: On a corpse on a ledge behind the gardens at Caria Manor.

Icon Shield.location: Inside a crumbling building at Woodfolk Ruins.

Inverted Hawk Heater Shield.location: On a body southeast of the Siofra River Bank Site of Grace, up a hill near the stairs to Hallowhorn Grounds.

Inverted Hawk Towershield.location: Drops from Fallen Hawks Soldiers found just outside the Nokron, Eternal City grace.

Iron Roundshield.location: Purchased from the Nomadic Merchant southeast of Coastal Cave.

Large Leather Shield.location: Purchased from Merchant Kale at the Church of Elleh for 600 Runes.

Lordsworn's Shield.location: Drops from Godrick Soldiers; several at Gatefront Ruins and on the path to Castleward Tunnel.

Man-Serpent's Shield.location: Uncommon drop from shield-wielding Man-Serpents in Volcano Manor; farm near the Guest Hall grace.

Marred Leather Shield.location: On a corpse along the wooden path up a slope from the Stormveil Cliffside grace (Gostoc's back route).

Marred Wooden Shield.location: From the Rampart Tower grace, drop down to a ledge after the walkway with explosive barrels and War Hawks.

Perfumer's Shield.location: Drops from Perfumer enemies; found at Perfumer's Grotto and the Shaded Castle inner gate.

Pillory Shield.location: Inside Gaol Cave (northeast of Fort Gael); requires 2 Stonesword Keys to access.

Red Crest Heater Shield.location: Sold by the Nomadic Merchant near the Forest-Spanning Greatbridge Site of Grace for 2,500 Runes.

Red Thorn Roundshield.location: Samurai class starting equipment; sold by a merchant on the eastern side of Weeping Peninsula for 600 Runes.

Rickety Shield.location: Drops from a group of Demi-Humans north of the South of the Lookout Tower Site of Grace.

Rift Shield.location: Purchased from a Nomadic Merchant for 1,800 Runes; Prisoner class starting equipment.

Riveted Wooden Shield.location: Bought from the Nomadic Merchant in East Limgrave for 600 Runes; Warrior class starting equipment.

Round Shield.location: Bought from the Nomadic Merchant on the eastern side of Weeping Peninsula for 1,000 Runes.

Scripture Wooden Shield.location: Drops from skeletons near the start of Deathtouched Catacombs; Astrologer class starting equipment.

Serpent Crest Shield.location: Reward for solving the Incursion Painting; the ghost appears west of the Greatbridge North grace near the dragon lake.

Shield of Night.location: On a ledge behind a corpse atop a table in Bonny Gaol; reach the top level via the jar lift near the bridge.

Shield of the Guilty.location: In the cellar of the Demi-Human Forest Ruins, before the Demi-Human Queen mini-boss.

Silver Mirrorshield.location: Inside the Apostate Derelict (destroyed church) in the northern area of Consecrated Snowfield.

Smithscript Shield.location: At Taylew's Ruined Forge; defeat the Golem Smiths and reach the upper platform at the end of the hallway.

Smoldering Shield.location: On a corpse in the graveyard reached from the Prison Town Church grace at Volcano Manor.

Spiked Palisade Shield.location: On a dead body under a Golem, west of the Deep Siofra Well.

Spiralhorn Shield.location: On a corpse at Uld Palace Ruins in northeast Liurnia, near the Walking Mausoleum from the Ruined Labyrinth grace.

Sun Realm Shield.location: Drops from a Sword & Shield Skeleton that crawls out southeast of Hermit Merchant's Shack.

Twinbird Kite Shield.location: Dropped by the Deathbird that spawns at night east of the Hermit Merchant's Shack grace in Leyndell.

Verdigris Greatshield.location: Dropped by NPC Moore when defeated; he invades near the Church of the Crusade / after the Forager Brood Pest.

Visage Shield.location: In a chest in an underground area east of Caelem Ruins, after the Mad Pumpkin Head duo.

Wolf Crest Shield.location: In a chest in a storeroom at Castle Ensis, reached through a gap in the northwest corner of Moonrithyll's courtyard.

Wooden Greatshield.location: Looted off a corpse on the guardhouse of the heavily guarded courtyard, near the Liftside Chamber grace.

[NPC] Golden Lion Shield.location: Given by Redmane Freyja after delivering the Letter for Freyja from Sir Ansbach.

[NPC] Shield of Night.location: Found in Bonny Gaol in Scadu Altus, on a ledge behind a corpse on a table.

[NPC] Verdigris Greatshield.location: Dropped by NPC Moore when defeated near the Church of the Crusade / Cerulean Coast questline.
